questions.question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85f7592b15d905fa90953d58dfb195eed01cc5dba7bbea7c88661f5f399bb967.png]
questions.solution:
In this case, we make two different arrangements of the digits from the positions of the dice. We note the digits in clockwise direction starting from the common digit. In both the arrangements, the digits written after the common digit are opposite to each other. 

 5 is the common digit in both the side, so the clockwise order of the digits is 

 5, 1, 4 (in first dice)

 5, 6, 3 (in the second dice)

Therefore, 1 is opposite to 6, 4 is opposite to 3 and 5 is opposite to 2(remaining digit).

Hence, the correct answer is .**5**

(40 Q 4 ) P 5 R (3 P 6) S (7 P 8) R 21 = ?

**10 × 5** + 18 - 56 + 21 = ?

33 = ?

Hence, the correct answer is **33.**

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(56, 8, 15)

(32, 16, 18)

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Divide the first number with second number and add the quotient to the second number to get the third number. 

56 ÷ 8 = 7 , 7 + 8 = 15

32 ÷ 16 = 2, 2+16 = 18

Option (1) 75 ÷ 5 = 15, 15+ 5 = 20 → Does not follow the pattern

Option (2) 70 ÷ 5 = 14, 14 + 5 = 19 → Does not follow the pattern

Option (3) 66 ÷ 6 = 11, 11 + 6 = 17 → Follows the pattern

Option (4) 68 ÷ 4 = 17, 17 + 4 = 21 → Does not follow the pattern

Therefore, Only option (3) is following this pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is** ****(66, 6, 17).**

questions.question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. When '3' is at the bottom, which number will be on the top?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/701891d4fbe1fa40e5626a9b02bde5ef9c28bb10f0dac11cbf4c9472a79ea961.png]
questions.solution:
The dice shown is a **standard dice**( because the sum of the adjacent sides is not equal to 7 ).

In a standard dice the opposite faces are as follows

1 and 6,or 1 is opposite to 6

2 and 5,or 2 is opposite to 5

3 and 4,or 3 is opposite to 4

In standard dice, the sum of opposite faces is equal to 7

Therefore, when '3' is at bottom, 4 will be on the top.

Hence, the correct answer is** 4.**

questions.question: The birth date of Viaan is 9 March 2002. Find the day of the week of that day.
questions.solution:
The number of odd days is zero in a century leap year (ie. 2000)

for 9 March 2002 = 1 odd day (2001) + 3 odd days (January 2002) + 2 odd days (9 days in March 2002)

= 1 + 3 + 2 = 6 odd days 

6 Odd days indicate Saturday.

Hence the correct answer is Saturday.

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

_ M o N _ _ _ o M _ _ o _ _o M _ N o J o

options.text: o o J o o N J o M
o o J o o N J o o
o M J o o N J o o
M o J o o N J o o

questions.solution:
Given: _ M o N _ _ _ o M _ _ o _ _o M _ N o J o

Let's check each option:

1) o o J o o N J o M → **__o__** M o N __o__ **__J__** __o__ o M __o__ **__N__** o __J__ __o__ o M **__M__** N o J o

2) **o o J o o N J o o** → __o__ M o N __o__ __J__ __o__ o M __o__ __N__ o __J__ __o__** **o M __o__ N o J o

3) o M J o o N J o o → __o__ M o N __M__ __J__ __o__ o M __o__ __N__ o __J__ __o__ o M __o__ N o J o

4) M o J o o N J o o → __M__ M o N __o__ __J__ __o__ o M __o__ __N__ o __J__ __o__ o M __o__ N o J o

So, In 2) "o M o N o J o" is repeating itself.

Hence, ‘o o J o o N J o o’ is the correct answer.
